At the Crossroads, Apothecary Helbrim receives Wolf Heart Sample. He studies how toxins from Lordaeron’s Scourge-ravaged lands affect Kalimdor’s native wildlife. The hearts’ preserved toxicity may reveal properties that improve Forsaken poisons and elixirs far from home.

item:wolf-heart-samples.text: Wolf Heart Samples. In Silverpine Forest, wolf hearts carry a poison their living hosts endure. Apothecary Renferrel sends samples to the Royal Apothecary Society for study. While examining carcasses in Silverpine Forest, Apothecary Renferrel found a deadly compound in certain wolf hearts. The poison fills their tissue at a strength that should kill them, yet the wolves live. Renferrel set tissue samples aside for delivery to Undercity. The Forsaken study creatures that endure toxins as they seek mastery of biological warfare and prepare new reagents. Couriers carry the samples beneath the ruins of Lordaeron to Apothecary Zinge. She works at the Royal Apothecary Society's headquarters in the Apothecarium. Zinge and her colleagues prize new toxins. They dissect and test the tainted tissue to isolate its virulent compounds and learn how the beasts survive them. They hope to use that knowledge in their alchemical work.

item:wood-pulp.text: Wood Pulp. At Bael Modan, Wood Pulp helps dwarven forces prepare their blasting charges. They carry it as an absorbent base for stabilizing liquid explosives. At Bael Modan, Ironforge dwarves use earth-moving equipment and chemical explosives to cut into ancestral tauren hunting grounds. Liquid nitroglycerin is unstable alone, so engineers soak it into porous wood pulp with sodium nitrate. The mixture makes stable charges for excavation and combat. Riflemen, soldiers, and officers carry bundles for sapping and field munitions.

item:wooden-key.text: Wooden Key. North of Raynewood Retreat, the Wooden Key passes through the hands of maddened ancients near Felwood. It opens a hidden chest with a piece of Dartol's Rod. Crazed and Withered Ancients carry the Wooden Key along shaded trails north of Raynewood Retreat. Shael'dryn once knew the local treants, but now says corruption has twisted them. One of the ancients carries the key to a chest with a piece of Dartol's Rod.

item:worn-parchment.text: Worn Parchment. At the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore, cultists gather and leave scraps of worn parchment in their belongings. North along Darkshore’s mist-shrouded coast, dark spellcasters and their followers have seized the ruined Tower of Althalaxx. Dark Strand Fanatics patrol the grounds and carry scraps of worn parchment among their belongings. One scrap holds only scattered writing and strange symbols. Gathered together, the fragments reveal an organization called the Cult of the Dark Strand.

item:worn-stone-token.text: Worn Stone Token. Across the Alterac Mountains, Worn Stone Tokens still bear the faded enchantments Dalaran made to command elementals. They remain in the hands of Dalaran's people, from mages to laborers. Dalaran's magi use talismans to bend elementals from other realms to their will. Worn Stone Tokens are spent examples of these tools. Theurgists and summoners carry them, along with Dalaran laborers and guards stationed around the ruins and internment camps of Alterac. Elemental binding reaches deep into Dalaran's daily work. At Tarren Mill, the Forsaken watch the nearby wizards. Magus Voidglare wants Worn Stone Tokens to study how Dalaran enslaves elementals. Keeper Bel'varil directs agents to gather worn, inert tokens first. They let the Magus examine basic enchanting safely before trying more potent, volatile conduits.

item:woven-wand.text: Woven Wand. Bethor Iceshard has the Woven Wand again in the Undercity. Three Dalaran apprentices made it as a pledge of brotherhood before betrayal and the fall of Lordaeron scattered them.

item:xavian-water-sample.text: Xavian Water Sample. At Xavian, Horde mages in Orgrimmar seek waters rich in arcane power. They hope to unravel the latent magic preserved in Ashenvale's oldest sacred sites. Xavian was once a fabled ancient elven city, and the learned still know its old wisdom. Though the city lies in ruin, its waters are said to hold great magical power. Deino, an arcane instructor in Orgrimmar, sends rising mages deep into Ashenvale to draw fresh water from the pool beneath Xavian's tallest waterfall. They must cross dangerous ground, where corrupt satyrs now guard the ruins fiercely and oppose spellcasters who meddle there.

item:young-crocolisk-skin.text:
Young Crocolisk Skin. In the Wetlands, young crocolisks supply hides for trade from Menethil Harbor. James Halloran cures their softer skins and sends them to distant ports. Menethil Harbor ships marsh goods from the western coast of Khaz Modan. Hides are among its most lucrative exports, cured by the town’s resident tanner, James Halloran. Full-grown crocolisks have thick, tough scales, while the young provide softer leather that is easier to work.

The delicate skins are in high demand. Halloran depends on local hunters and passing travelers to search the boggy marshes just outside town and keep his curing racks stocked.

item:yowler-s-paw.text: Yowler's Paw. In Lakeshire, Verner Osgood receives Yowler's Paw as proof that the feared gnoll leader is dead. Yowler leads the packs that menace the hills above the town. Yowler leads the Redridge gnolls that terrorize the heights around Lake Everstill. Their howls reach Lakeshire. Feared above all, Yowler is a ruthless alpha who drives the packs' expansion. Verner Osgood asks for his paw as the customary proof of a bounty across human territories. The trophy marks the death of an unusually cunning predator and strikes at the command of his disorganized followers. Lakeshire faces danger with little help from Stormwind. The Stormwind Army is consumed by the Blackrock orc threat entrenched around Stonewatch Keep. Civil authorities and townspeople must hire passing mercenaries for defense. Without regular royal garrisons, settlers such as Verner Osgood rely on proof that threats have been dealt with, keeping local roads marginally safe for trade and travel.

item:zalazane-s-head.text:
Zalazane's Head. Master Gadrin seeks proof that Zalazane has fallen. The Darkspear long for relief from the witch doctor who drove them from the Echo Isles. Master Gadrin asks you to prove that Zalazane is dead. The witch doctor betrayed the Darkspear and seized their island home with hexes that enslaved minds. His magic drove Vol'jin's people to Durotar's shores.

From the Echo Isles, Zalazane still sends hexed thralls across the water to seize more victims. Sen'jin Village needs proof that his rule has ended. His severed head confirms his defeat and brings the displaced tribe some peace, with hope of reclaiming their stolen islands one day.

item:zamah-s-note.text: Zamah's Note. In Thunder Bluff, Zamah sends an urgent plea to Tarren Mill. She asks Apothecary Lydon for an alchemical way to drive the Venture Company from Stonetalon without bloodshed. The Venture Company has dug deep into the Stonetalon Mountains. Its goblins fell trees and tear up sacred land, so Zamah seeks a way to drive them out without slaughter. She turns to the Forsaken Royal Apothecary Society for help. Her note warns her colleague Apothecary Lydon of the danger in Stonetalon. Lydon is far away in Tarren Mill, in the Hillsbrad Foothills of Lordaeron. The sealed note must cross continents to reach Lydon. Travelers from Kalimdor take a zeppelin to the Undercity, then go south through Silverpine Forest into Hillsbrad. Word from across the ocean intrigues Lydon, and he prepares an alchemical answer to the goblin problem.

item:zargh-s-meats.text: Zargh's Meats. At the Crossroads, Zargh prepares fresh meat for Gryshka in Orgrimmar. The parcel gives young Horde travelers a reason to learn the wind rider route. Zargh hunts and butchers at the Crossroads in the Barrens, preparing fresh cuts for Gryshka, the innkeeper in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. The savanna heat can spoil game quickly, so couriers carry the parcel to the Crossroads roost. There, Wind Rider Master Devrak arranges a wyvern flight to Orgrimmar's Skytower. The flight spares travelers the long overland journey through Durotar. Zargh sends more than provisions with his delivery. When Gryshka receives the meat, she recognizes his knack for winning a lady's favor with quality game. She is eager to prepare the cuts for the inn's patrons and guests. For newly arrived orc and troll travelers, the delivery gives a reason to learn long-distance flight between Kalimdor's Horde settlements.

item:zhevra-hooves.text:
Zhevra Hooves. Across the Barrens, zhevras graze the open savannah, swift prey with a powerful kick. Their hooves show that a hunter can face them. Zhevras roam the Barrens on compact, muscular legs that can strike hard. Sergra Darkthorn, the orc shaman in charge of the Crossroads, sends new Horde scouts to gather the hooves of zhevra runners. The hunt tests a young hunter's instincts and resilience. A panicked runner can knock even a sturdy tauren flat.

Intact hooves show a hunter can handle swift, kicking prey before facing Kalimdor's deadliest predators.
